description: This source file defines a test utility class OrderBuilder used for constructing Order objects with default or specified values, primarily for unit testing purposes in the eShopOnWeb application.

classes.name: OrderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating Order instances with default or custom data for unit testing.

methods.name: OrderBuilder()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the OrderBuilder with default CatalogItemOrdered and a default Order object.

methods.name: WithDefaultValues
methods.description: Sets the Order to default values including a default OrderItem and Address.

methods.name: WithNoItems
methods.description: Sets the Order with no order items.

methods.name: WithItems
methods.description: Sets the Order with a specific list of OrderItems.
